title: An update of a task the store does not hold is refused, nothing written: an update is no creation
notes: Python: tests/test_store_room_contract.py::test_a_write_naming_what_the_store_lacks_is_refused[update_task] (RMK-1113, decided by the maintainer on 2026-11-01). Before, InMemoryStore kept the task where get_task found it and list_tasks did not, SQLiteStore created it, and PostgresStore wrote nothing.
